text:
olivia: CI canary push failed for service `api-gateway`
olivia: ECR reject on publish - error says 'ImageManifestInvalid: manifest failed signature verification'
deploy-bot: [deploy aborted] canary rollout aborted for api-gateway @canary - v2026.3.2
sam: which step failed? build or push? paste logs pls
ci-cd-bot: publish step (step 4/5) failed. snippet:
```
# aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/api-gateway --image-manifest file://manifest.json
An error occurred (ImageManifestInvalid) when calling the PutImage operation: manifest failed signature verification
```
maria: looks like the manifest we pushed doesn't match the signed attestation we generated with cosign. might be a mutation during registry upload or multi-platform ordering mismatch
noah: we've seen this before when buildx + cache produced different manifest list order vs local cosign signing. cosign verifies against exact manifest digest. if that reorders, signature fails
sam: can we just re-sign the pushed image? or pin by digest and rollback?
olivia: can we rollback the canary to the previous image digest while we fix publish? previous digest: sha256:3a7f9c2b1e4d5c6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0
maria: yes rollback + pin is safest. I'll update helm values to use image.digest: sha256:3a7f9c2b... and push a quick patch PR to stop the v2026.3.2 rollout
ci-cd-bot: rollback job queued: infra/helm-rollback #482 - started
noah: for republish, plan: 1) rebuild with `--no-cache` and fixed buildx (v0.10.0) 2) `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push -t 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api-gateway:2026.3.2 --output type=registry` 3) run `cosign sign --key k8s://cosign-key` after push 4) run `cosign verify` against registry digest and confirm
sam: also let's avoid mutable tags - we'll sign by digest and update release metadata to pin digests in release notes
olivia: ok i'm creating a release note update now to mention republish + pinned digest + rollback rationale
maria: i'm going to republish now with `--no-cache` and explicit platforms, then sign. i'll report back with new digest
maria: republish done. new digest: sha256:9f1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1
maria: cosign verify output:
```
Verification for 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api-gateway@sha256:9f1b2c... : OK
The artifact has been signed using tlog entry: 1234567890
```
sam: nice. maria can you also push a manifest-digest tag like `2026.3.2@sha256:9f1b...` into the release assets? we'll update deploy config to use the digest form not tag
maria: done. updated helm values PR: #2045, and release notes updated under changelog section "2026.3.2 (republished)" with digest and explanation
olivia: once helm PR merges, can we resume canary?
deploy-bot: [rollout resumed] canary for api-gateway v2026.3.2 -> pinned to digest sha256:9f1b... - traffic 5%
deploy-bot: canary traffic -> 10% after 10m
oah: also filing a follow-up to CI: pin buildx version in pipeline and disable multistep manifest mutation. I'll add a test that verifies cosign verify against the registry digest as part of publish
sam: add an alert if cosign verify fails on push so we don't auto-rollout
maria: i've added a transient step in pipeline that runs `cosign verify` and fails publish unless ok. raising PR now
olivia: thanks all. summary for notes: rollback to previous digest, republish with buildx no-cache + explicit platforms, sign with cosign, pin digest in helm, add cosign verify to pipeline, avoid mutable tags.
ci-cd-bot: rollback completed, helm patch applied, canary resumed and healthy.
deploy-bot: [rollout success] api-gateway v2026.3.2 pinned-by-digest deployed to prod canary -> full rollout scheduled
noah: follow-up ticket: INFRA-712 (pin buildx + cosign verify on publish)
sam: great handling. :thumbsup:
